features.feature: checkLint/runTsc accept optional changedFiles; tsconfigs out of change scope are soft-skipped when changedFiles is provided
no changedFiles (plain --lint, no story) runs full recursive tsc unchanged (backward compatible)
diff reader throws (no merge-base/detached HEAD) falls back to full recursive tsc, never skip-all
changed file under no tsconfig subtree or ambiguous mapping treated in-scope (fail-closed)
verifier.ts call site: thread args.story -> changedFiles when --lint --story (validate --lint path)
review-preflight.ts call site: REVIEW->TEST preflight checkLint also threads story changedFiles; falls back to full recursive tsc when scope unresolvable
out-of-scope tsconfig whose package has no node_modules is skipped-with-warning (out of scope, deps absent) instead of hard fail
in-scope tsconfig with real tsc error still surfaces as kind:fail (gate bites)
out-of-scope tsconfig WITH node_modules present is still type-checked (not skipped)
node_modules presence probe is injectable (FileExists DI) so smoke test needs no real fs install
regression tests: backend-only change scopes out frontend (skipped), in-scope error still kind:fail, no-scope full recursive, diff-throw fallback all-pass
smoke test never spawns real tsc (uses injected CommandRunner + injected diff reader only)
